FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE
  -- Compute age on 2026-09-24
  (
    -- Age = year difference
    CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS age
  ) = 25

  -- Check month/day: birthday must have occurred on or before 2026-09-24
  SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 5) <= '09-24'

  -- If birthday is in September, day must be <= 24; otherwise any day is fine

    CASE
      WHEN SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) = '09' THEN SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 9, 2)
      ELSE '99'
    END
  ) <= '24';
